<style>
.charge40-article{--navy:#10233f;--orange:#e97828;--soft:#fff6ed;--line:#e5d4c3;--text:#293548;--muted:#637184;--cool:#eef8fa;max-width:100%;color:var(--text);font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.charge40-article,.charge40-article *{box-sizing:border-box}
.charge40-article p{margin:0 0 1.05em}
.charge40-article h2{margin:2.35em 0 .72em;padding:.22em 0 .22em .72em;border-left:5px solid var(--orange);color:var(--navy);font-size:1.5em;line-height:1.45}

.charge40-answer{margin:0 0 1.15em;padding:1.05em 1.15em;border:1px solid #efbc8f;border-left:6px solid var(--orange);border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff3e7,#fff)}

.charge40-answer strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.1em;line-height:1.65}
.charge40-points,.charge40-flow,.charge40-roles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:1.05em 0 1.5em}
.charge40-card{min-width:0;padding:.95em 1em;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(16,35,63,.055)}
.charge40-card b{display:block;margin-bottom:.3em;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.5}
.charge40-card span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.91em;line-height:1.72}
.charge40-flow .charge40-card{position:relative;text-align:center;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.charge40-flow .charge40-card b{color:#fff}
.charge40-flow .charge40-card span{color:#d9edf1}
.charge40-note{margin:1.2em 0;padding:1em 1.1em;border:1px solid #c7e2e7;border-radius:10px;background:var(--cool)}
.charge40-note strong{color:var(--navy)}
.charge40-warning{margin:1.2em 0;padding:1em 1.1em;border:1px solid #efd595;border-radius:10px;background:#fff7e5}

.charge40-role b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.04em}

.charge40-media{margin:1.35em auto;max-width:680px}

.charge40-media figcaption{margin:.62em .1em 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.86em;line-height:1.65}
.charge40-media--summary{max-width:820px}
.charge40-refs{padding-left:1.35em}
